lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - 1. Listen and point.

details: Listen and point checks understanding of word meaning and sound as students match what they hear to the right image.
Look for careful listening and correct pointing to the appropriate image.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p12 - 4. What’s on your face? Draw.

details: What’s on your face? Draw provides the opportunity to further practise the target language in a more engaging way and raises awareness of how many of each feature students have on their face.
Look for students including all of the features commonly found on a face and correctly identifying which ones there are one of and which ones there are two of, and drawing them in the correct box.
